analysis.title: EQ Technical Analysis - Bearish potential emerged in SAP
key_insights: UBS S&T technical outlook on the S&P 500 moved from bullish to neutral. Spot ref 7549.94 (last closed 9 Nov), after slipping from 7580.07 on the 2 Nov review. Price failed to hold above the Cloud and was rejected by it on 9 Nov. A close below 7257.33 would turn the outlook bearish. A rebound above the Cloud (resistance 7702.88) would restore a bullish outlook targeting 7829.00, then 8085.48.

UBS S&T turned bearish on the Nasdaq Composite after it closed below 24,425.34 on 5 Nov. Spot ref 25,253.14. Targets are 23,976.84, then 22,920.66. Rebounds are viewed as corrective, with upside expected to be rejected at Cloud resistance 26,764.58.

Hang Seng stays bearish with a target of 22,668.35. Spot ref 24,573.83, up from 23,441.63 on 2 Nov. The 22 Oct gap-down has been filled, and UBS expects the 5 Nov gap to be filled, implying a decline to 23,919.50. UBS would turn only neutral on a break above the Cloud (24,962.47) and needs a close above 26,836.66 for a bullish view.

CSI 300 stays bearish with targets of 3829.25 and 3704.44. Spot ref 4064.07. UBS flags a risk of a near-term rebound toward 4513.45 because of unfilled gap-downs from 24 and 26 Sep. That move would likely clear the Cloud (4430.34) and could tilt the outlook bullish.

Nikkei 225 turned bearish after closing below 59,332.43 on 6 Nov. Spot ref 60,424.22, down from 63,245.65 on 2 Nov. Targets are 54,487.32, then 52,636.87. Rebounds are seen as corrective. A rebound above Cloud resistance 67,249.90 would restore a bullish outlook targeting 72,831.73.

EURO Stoxx 50 stays bearish on a completed head and shoulders top, with a textbook target of 5811.16, then 5762.15. Spot ref 6290.45. UBS tolerates rebounds to 6365.40, above which the pattern is invalid. A close above the Cloud (6373.84) is needed for a bullish view targeting 6577.20.

Rheinmetall stays bearish. The prior 933.00 target was broken on 5 Nov and the new targets are 774.60, then 661.60. Spot ref 845.90, down from 1030.40. UBS expects a near-term rebound to 945.50 to correct the overextension below the lower Bollinger band and fill the 5 Nov gap-down.

SAP short-term outlook is still bullish, but UBS flags bearish potential from a rising wedge. Spot ref 211.85, with price above the Cloud. The rebound failed to test the upper Bollinger band and downward momentum lingers. Targets are 219.45 (reached but not broken), then 243.40. A break below the support trendline would complete the wedge and imply a decline of 42.29 from the breakdown point. A break above the resistance trendline invalidates the pattern.

UBS admitted its bullish calls on the S&P 500 and Nasdaq at the 2 Nov review were wrong. Both indices fell against its expectation, and it has since moved to neutral on the S&P 500 and bearish on the Nasdaq and Nikkei.

market_movers.rationale: The UBS research rating is Buy with a EUR 1,100 PT. The S&T technical view is bearish, with new targets of 774.60 and 661.60 and a near-term rebound expected to 945.50.
The UBS research rating is Neutral with a EUR 210 PT. The S&T technical view is bullish above the Cloud, but a rising wedge shows bearish potential.
